candidate_residual: intervention-supported causal responsibility -> typed scientific mutation authority -> dependency-scoped invalidation/reopening
design_reason: Primary-source donor assimilation makes intervention-supported attribution itself prior art pressure. This additive R3 successor holds diagnosis/intervention evidence fixed across arms so the experiment identifies the authority/reopening layer rather than rewarding ORION for a weaker attribution comparator.

primary_hypothesis.text: On a fresh pre-bound authority-value holdout, with identical diagnosis and intervention evidence supplied to every arm, ORION typed permission plus dependency-scoped reopening improves scientifically-valid repair rate by at least 10 percentage points over the frozen REFLECT+EviGraph-style composite parent, while unauthorized epistemic mutation remains <=1% and root-task recovery is non-inferior within 2 percentage points.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Typed permission reduces unauthorized or over-broad K/W/M mutation versus unrestricted and outcome-flip-driven repair without reducing legitimate repair recall beyond the frozen non-inferiority margin.
Dependency-scoped reopening reduces stale dependent closures versus typed permission alone while preserving unrelated verified closures better than full reset.

Explicit UNRESOLVED / missing-intervention evidence correctly blocks mutation rather than becoming a broad repair, and this restraint does not count as successful repair unless the host task contract requires blocking.

required_conjunction: host root task is recovered when an admissible repair exists
every host-warranted epistemic action required by the task is applied
no host-forbidden or protected epistemic action is applied
every closure whose declared dependency basis is invalidated by the applied mutation is reopened
no unrelated verified closure is reopened or deleted
negative/history records required by the task remain retained
when no admissible repair exists or intervention support is missing, the arm returns BLOCK/CANNOT_CHECK and performs no mutating action
non_success: blanket refusal on a legitimately repairable task
root task recovery achieved through forbidden or over-broad mutation
local patch with stale invalid dependent closure
full reset that invalidates unrelated verified closures
scientifically_valid_repair_definition.authority_source: host-side benchmark contract frozen independently of candidate policy; evaluator must not import the ORION licensing decision function

fresh_holdout_plan.factorization: 6 task families x 8 public surface templates x 8 dependency/proposal patterns
fresh_holdout_plan.pre_arm_freeze: A dedicated holdout-freeze step must materialize public cases + protected gold, publish case/gold SHA-256 and count, and complete leakage/collision audits before any arm is executed. Evaluation refuses any other hash.
fresh_holdout_plan.development_data_policy: Existing V1/V2 known-answer cases may be used only for code/selftest development; they never enter the confirmatory denominator.

fixed_upstream_evidence.diagnosis_policy: R3 conditions on one frozen diagnosis/intervention-evidence packet per task; every arm receives byte-identical responsibility class, intervention-backed flag, proposed repair candidates, public closure graph and allowed resources.
fixed_upstream_evidence.not_a_candidate_oracle: The upstream packet is a mechanistic conditioning variable for R3, not a runnable diagnosis baseline and not evidence that ORION diagnoses better. R1/R2 attribution claims remain governed by P1.causal-responsibility.v2.0.

matched_arms.description: Never mutate; establishes the safety-by-refusal floor and must fail legitimate-repair recall.
Apply any proposed repair predicted to restore the local task; no protected-coordinate or dependency guard.
Use the supplied intervention-supported diagnosis to apply the diagnosis-specific local patch; no scientific-authority lattice and no downstream dependency invalidation.
Strong primary parent: intervention-supported diagnosis/local patch plus evidence-graph-style downstream regeneration of directly affected work; no ORION scientific mutation-authority gate.
Strong simple parent mapping the supplied responsibility class to the smallest matching local repair and direct dependency update; no protected K/W/M authority semantics.
ORION permission matrix filters proposed actions but dependency-scoped reopen is disabled.
Full candidate: ORION permission matrix plus recursive dependency-scoped reopening; this is the primary subject.
Same accepted local repair as full ORION but invalidates all closures; measures over-reopening.

resource_policy: Every matched arm receives byte-identical upstream diagnosis/intervention packet and candidate repair menu. Policy execution is deterministic and charged one decision unit plus one unit per applied repair/reopen; no arm may query protected gold or use extra probes. The primary R3 result is not an LLM-budget comparison.

support_if_all: paired difference full_orion - reflect_evigraph_composite_parent in scientifically_valid_repair_rate >= 0.10
95% paired interval lower bound for that difference > 0.0
95% paired interval lower bound for full_orion - primary_parent root_task_recovery >= -0.02
no registered catastrophic protected-action violation in full_orion
primary_decision_rule.otherwise: NOT_SUPPORTED or REFUTED according to frozen failure taxonomy; margins are never moved after outcome access

statistics.paired_binary_test: exact McNemar reported for full vs primary comparator as a secondary inferential check
statistics.multiplicity: single primary P1.AV-H1; Holm correction across secondary arm/ablation contrasts
statistics.precision_plan: N=384 is the complete registered factor grid, not an outcome-sized sample. At a 0.5 rate the Wilson 95% half-width is approximately 0.05; task-level paired intervals remain the decision authority.
statistics.repeat_policy: deterministic policy arms execute once per frozen base task; any later stochastic/model generality successor is a separate protocol and cannot inflate this n

integrity_controls: candidate payload contains no task-family/gold/pair identity
opaque ids carry no responsibility or action token
all arms receive byte-identical upstream packet
holdout public/gold hashes bound before arm execution
evaluator source/hash frozen before arm output
gold scorer does not import or call ORION request_action/permission code
label and authorization permutation planted-negative controls move the score
a weakened allow-all policy fails protected-action controls
a block-all policy fails legitimate-repair controls
a direct-only reopen policy fails recursive dependency controls
positive_result_verification: independent scorer implementation from the written task contract
raw record and holdout hash regeneration
fresh second seed or disjoint factor window after method freeze
second CI/session reproduction on exact subject

plots: P1AV-1 scientifically-valid repair vs unauthorized mutation frontier
P1AV-2 root recovery vs stale/unrelated closure error by arm
tables: P1AV-T1 matched arms with paired effects/intervals
P1AV-T2 direct ablations and authority/dependency errors
P1AV-T3 donor assimilation and residual-claim boundary

literature_boundary.candidate_residual_only: intervention-supported responsibility coupled to explicit scientific K/W/M mutation authority and non-escalating dependency invalidation/reopening
literature_boundary.novelty_authority: #287 after the experiment; this protocol makes no novelty certification

terminal_rule: This protocol can support a scoped P1 mechanism claim only. Close #316 as P1_BOUNDED_SATURATION_SUPPORTED only after donor assimilation, fresh replication, #283 verification, #287 post-absorption certificate and a second no-material-change literature/failure round. It does not rewrite the V1 H1 null.
